This notebook runs the project analysis and displays its main results. The root README contains the full report, including the dataset accessions, methods, discussion, and references.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath("..", winslash = "/"))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, fig.align = "center", out.width = "90%")
```

## Run the analysis

The existing R script reads the bundled FASTA, checks the six reference records, and writes the tables, alignment, and figures used below.

```{r analysis}
source("code/01_bacterial_sequence_analysis.R", local = TRUE)
```

## Nucleotide composition and GC content

```{r nucleotide-table}
nucleotides <- read.csv("results/nucleotide_analysis.csv")
nucleotides$Ambiguous_Bases <- nucleotides$Length -
  rowSums(nucleotides[c("A", "T", "G", "C")])
nucleotides$GC_Content <- sprintf("%.2f", nucleotides$GC_Content)
knitr::kable(
  nucleotides[c("Species", "Length", "Ambiguous_Bases", "GC_Content")],
  col.names = c("Species", "Length (nt)", "Ambiguous bases", "GC (%)"),
  caption = "Sequence length, ambiguous base counts, and GC content by record."
)
```

```{r composition, echo=FALSE, fig.cap="Nucleotide composition as a percentage of each record's length."}
knitr::include_graphics(normalizePath("results/nucleotide_composition.png", winslash = "/"), rel_path = FALSE)
```

```{r gc, echo=FALSE, fig.cap="GC content calculated using total sequence length."}
knitr::include_graphics(normalizePath("results/gc_content_comparison.png", winslash = "/"), rel_path = FALSE)
```

## Aligned similarity and clustering

The heatmap shows similarity calculated from uncorrected overlap distances. The dendrogram summarizes the same distances using average linkage.

```{r heatmap, echo=FALSE, fig.cap="Pairwise 16S rRNA similarity percentages."}
knitr::include_graphics(normalizePath("results/sequence_similarity_heatmap.png", winslash = "/"), rel_path = FALSE)
```

```{r dendrogram, echo=FALSE, fig.cap="Average-linkage dendrogram with the three-group cut outlined."}
knitr::include_graphics(normalizePath("results/bacterial_clustering.png", winslash = "/"), rel_path = FALSE)
```

```{r clusters}
clusters <- read.csv("results/bacterial_cluster_groups.csv")
knitr::kable(clusters[c("Species", "Cluster")],
             caption = "Reference records and their assigned groups.")
```

## Sensitivity to shared alignment positions

This check repeats the comparison using only alignment columns where all six
records have a called A, T, G, or C. Each pair is compared over the same columns.
The resulting mismatch proportions are clustered using the same average linkage
and three-group cut.

```{r shared-position-summary, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
comparison <- read.csv("results/shared_position_comparison.csv")
same_group <- comparison$Same_Overlap_Group == comparison$Same_Shared_Group
similarity_change <- abs(comparison$Shared_Similarity_Percent -
                           comparison$Overlap_Similarity_Percent)
cat(sprintf(
  paste("The check retained **%d of %d alignment columns**.",
        "Group membership agreed for **%d of %d pairs**.",
        "The largest similarity change was **%.2f percentage points**."),
  comparison$Shared_Columns[1], width(aligned_sequences)[1],
  sum(same_group), nrow(comparison), max(similarity_change)
))
```

```{r shared-position-plot, echo=FALSE, fig.cap="Each point represents a sequence pair. The dashed diagonal marks equal similarity under both methods."}
knitr::include_graphics(normalizePath("results/shared_position_similarity.png", winslash = "/"), rel_path = FALSE)
```

```{r shared-position-boxplot, echo=FALSE, fig.cap="Box plots of the same 15 pairwise similarities under both methods. The boxes show the middle 50%, the center lines mark the medians, and the dots show individual scores."}
knitr::include_graphics(normalizePath("results/shared_position_boxplot.png", winslash = "/"), rel_path = FALSE)
```

```{r shared-position-table, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    Record_1 = comparison$Record_1,
    Record_2 = comparison$Record_2,
    Overlap = sprintf("%.2f", comparison$Overlap_Similarity_Percent),
    Shared = sprintf("%.2f", comparison$Shared_Similarity_Percent),
    Original_Group = ifelse(comparison$Same_Overlap_Group, "Yes", "No"),
    Shared_Group = ifelse(comparison$Same_Shared_Group, "Yes", "No")
  ),
  col.names = c("Record 1", "Record 2", "Overlap similarity (%)",
                "Shared-position similarity (%)", "Same group (overlap)",
                "Same group (shared)"),
  caption = "Pairwise similarity and group membership under both comparisons."
)
```
